title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the gravitational mass of the galaxy in units of the sun's mass.

title: Use of Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the gravitational force equations for both the sun and the galaxy.

title: Velocity Calculations
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the velocities of the sun and the earth using their respective periods and distances.

title: Mass Ratio Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the mass ratio correctly using the distances and velocities derived.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of gravitational equations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss any limiting cases or assumptions made in the problem.
